findings.label: Z-pin on forward only
findings.detail: _apply_kinematic_motion writes KINEMATIC_STAND_Z only for the walk_forward action; turn and idle ticks do not re-assert z and rely on resetPhysics()/hold_standing(). Minor asymmetry, not a defect. User should confirm in Webots that the torso stays at ~0.24 while turning or stationary.

findings.label: Runtime behaviors unverified (no Webots)
findings.detail: Realistic speed, stop-at-barrier, upright torso and is_fallen()=False are validated only by the in-memory mock tests and the recorded stable-baselines3 check_env runs; no Webots runtime exists in this environment. The author documented the four manual checks in config.py and README; the user must run them in Webots.
